# Local animation dependencies

- GSAP and ScrollTrigger **3.12.5**: https://www.npmjs.com/package/gsap/v/3.12.5 — copyright GreenSock; license information is preserved in the distribution headers at https://gsap.com/standard-license/.

Downloaded from the corresponding versioned `cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/` distributions.
No runtime CDN connection is needed. Keep license headers when updating these files.
The editorial team module loads these files on demand. The earlier Three.js network and its dependency have been removed.
